label: RECEPTION_OF_ESSE_1: EsseReceivedIn x r: the act of being of x is received in the principle r…
definition: EsseReceivedIn x r: the act of being of x is received in the principle r, which stands to it as receiving potency to received act (De ente c.3 [69874], c.4 [69875]; ST I q.7 a.1-2). The relation is indexed to the esse of a particular thing; r ranges over the same Principle sort as essenceOf and esseOf of q.3 a.4. In Lean it is a parameter constrained only by the premises that use it.
note: Structural properties are not built in: that a receiver is the thing's essence and that it is in receptive potency to the received esse are separate premises (STMT-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN-OWN-ESSENCE, STMT-RECEIVER-IN-POTENCY-TO-RECEIVED-ESSE), each shown necessary by STMT-SUBSISTENT-INFINITY-RECEPTION-CONTROLS. Examples: per De ente c.4, an intelligence's esse is received in its quiddity. Non-examples: a form received in matter (a different act and receiver), a quality in a subject, and an efficient cause giving esse 'from another' (DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION). OPEN: whether reception of esse is a real constitution of its bearer and its relation to the Composite predicate, as recorded in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md. What would source it as a definition: a passage defining reception of esse rather than applying it.
